title: Order and Chaos
subtitle: The scale once tried to measure it all.

items.text: City Hall

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Let go of the hostage, sir. This won't do you any good.

items.speaker: Enraged Man
items.text: Go away!!

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Damn!

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: That was close! Where's our backup?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: DAA, at your service.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: What's the situation?

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: See for yourself.
The City Hall, usually bustling with foot traffic, now stands eerily empty. The reason is immediately clear.

items.speaker: Enraged Man
items.text: Don't come any closer! Stay back! Stay back!!

items.speaker: Hostage
items.text: Please! Don't kill me! I'm sorry, I really am! Please let me go!

items.speaker: Enraged Man
items.text: Shut up! It's too late now. Say another word, and you're dead! Stay back!!
He swings the blade in his hand wildly, his voice a furious, panicked snarl.
The crowd on the other side of the police barricade instinctively recoils, but the woman standing just ten paces away doesn't move an inch.
Hey, hey. Trust me, pal.
You really don't want to do this.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Who's that? Doesn't look like one of ours.

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Just some civvy. She was talking with the suspect before we got here.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: That woman ...

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What, you know her? Look familiar or something?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: No. Just a thought. It's nothing.
The woman glances toward the officers, seeming to notice their conversation.
People make mistakes. But some mistakes can't be undone. Don't put that blood on your hands, or it'll never wash off.
Is hurting this guy worth all that pain and guilt?
Sooner or later, he'll get what's coming to him for what he's done. I promise you that.
Her words seem to have an effect. The hostage-taker hesitates, his face contorted in pain, his grip on the knife faltering.

items.speaker: Enraged Man
items.text: But, but, I must ...

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: He's distracted. Rookie, time for us to take him down!

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Please stand down, sir.
Although almost half his size, Liáng manages to pin the suspect to the ground. The other officers swarm in, snapping handcuffs around his wrists before he can put up another fight.

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Suspect under control. I repeat, suspect under control. No further backup needed.
Looks like this case is wrapped up.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Nice moves. I was kinda hoping we'd get to see that familiar of yours, though.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: A simple threat like this isn't worthy of Qiángliáng. I have to reserve its assistance unless absolutely necessary.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: So, is this just another one of those rules? Or, do you mean its help comes with a price tag?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Both.
Despite the curtness of her response, her eyes widen a little at Poitier's astuteness.
Poitier scowls.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: That it?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: What do you mean?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: I mean, so far, every time you talk about the job or your family rules, it's just the surface-level stuff. How do you actually feel about any of this?
Liáng looks genuinely confused.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: How I feel? I-I don't understand why it would be necessary to mention that.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Cause we're partners, kid. We've got to trust each other. How am I gonna let you watch my six if I don't even know how you tick?
But Liáng still doesn't seem to get it.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I see. You're my partner and instructor during my assignment with the LAPD Division of Arcane Affairs.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: So, I will do my best to learn from you and complete my work as assigned. I won't slow you down.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: That's not what I'm—Urgh. Forget it.
Liáng's tone all but says, "My personal feelings don't matter." Poitier gives up trying to argue with someone with such a stubborn, unreadable demeanor.
She simply stares at her, quietly seething to herself. Luckily, before things can spiral further, the hostage cuts through the tension.

items.speaker: Hostage
items.text: Oh, thank God you took down that lunatic. I'm really grateful, Miss.

items.speaker: Hostage
items.text: But, ain't you a bit young to be an Arcane Affairs Officer? I think I've seen that uniform somewhere else before. You're a vigil, right?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Yes, sir. Wait.
Liáng swallows the rest of her words as she stares at the hostage she just rescued, her expression suddenly wary.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I know you.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: The arcanist scammer, Johnny Three-Times, has been apprehended. Using his arcane skill "Omnis Obeisance," he manipulated his victims to do anything he asked, specifically, transferring all their money to him.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: You're that scammer, Johnny Three-Times.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: Oopsie. Guess that's the downside of getting your name in the papers.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What? Didn't we already book that guy? What's he doing here?

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: He got a sweetheart deal. A reduced sentence in exchange for revealing where he stashed all the dough he stole.

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: And it was a s**tload of money too, apparently from some big donors to the mayor's re-election campaign.

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Of course, he demanded he be present for the unveiling of his stash. So, they brought him here. That's when this loony attacked the police escort and took him hostage.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: Hey, easy, officer. You've already got me. No need to be so rough with the cuffs.

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Clam it, Johnny.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: We should've just let that guy ice him.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: May I ask, officer, do we know if the man trying to kill him was—

items.speaker: Old Police Officer
items.text: Yeah, he's the son of a victim. This bastard took his mom for all she was worth, and when she found out—boom—heart attack.
He shakes his head, heaving a weary sigh. Johnny Three-Times snickers.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: Ha. Like mother, like son. He was just as dumb as his doddering old mom. Worse even, cause he didn't even catch wise to it.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: It's a concrete jungle, baby, and it follows jungle rules. Survival of the fittest. Crap for brains here never had a chance.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: If it wasn't me, it woulda been someone else. What a joke! Imagine keeling over just cause you lost a bit of cash.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: Then we've got this dumbass, coming at me with even less of a brain. Think about it. If he killed me, how's he gonna get his money back?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Shut the f**k up, asshole!
She levels a punch to his gut, sending him crumpling to the ground, gasping for air.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: UGH!

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Officer Poitier, what are you doing?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What? I'm teaching this douchebag a lesson.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: But we can't do that. It's against the rules.
Liáng steps between the two, blocking Poitier from doing any more.

items.speaker: Johnny Three-Times
items.text: *cough* Well, I guess the Vigiles are a cut above the trash when it comes to the DAA. Am I right?
Poitier takes a deep breath as she tries to rein in her frustration.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Let's get this straight, rookie. You don't tell me what to do.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: I should've known. You're just the worst kind of cop—Everything by the book, sticking to your high-and-mighty principles like you know what's best.
She lets out a frosty huff and turns away.

items.speaker: Girl
items.text: Liáng Yuè! How dare you rat us out?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Be-Because you did something wrong.

items.speaker: Girl
items.text: Then you're a rat. I didn't really care if you wanted to come along, but now you go and snitch on us?

items.speaker: Boy
items.text: I told you we shouldn't have invited her.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Wait, don't go.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I—
The clamor of fearful voices cuts her off.

items.speaker: Young Police Officer
items.text: No. Somebody stop him.
